sloka: रोष रोदन ताम्राक्षी भीमाक्षम् राक्षस अधिपम् ।रुदती करुणम् सीता ह्रियमाणा इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-५३-२॥
transliteration: roṣa rodana tāmrākṣī bhīmākṣam rākṣasa adhipam ।rudatī karuṇam sītā hriyamāṇā idam abravīt ॥3-53-2॥

translations.english: While being carried away, Sita wept piteously and her eyes went red with tears of anger and grief. Looking at the frightening eyes of the king of the demons, she said these words :
